title: Point-in-Time Encoders for Earnings Calls
abstract: arXiv:2611.14325v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text encoders turn earnings calls into vectors for search, for language models that answer from retrieved passages, and for forecasting models. A live retriever can use an encoder trained once on all available text, as finance retrievers are, but a backtest needs an encoder that read no text written after the date of each vector. To address this look-ahead bias, from 412,248 calls we train vintages under four pretraining recipes, with yearly cutoffs from 2010 to 2024, and each vintage reads only text dated on or before its cutoff. We then fine-tune each vintage on the question-answer pairs of the calls themselves. The vintages we train on calls alone, with 33.8M parameters, retrieve answers on held-out calls better than the general retrievers we tested in every test quarter. Their vectors also raise by about half the rank correlation between next-day returns and forecasts built from past returns and firm size. When each vintage continues

translated_title: 财报电话会议的时点编码器
translated_abstract: 文本编码器将财报电话会议转换为向量，用于搜索、用于基于检索段落进行回答的语言模型，以及用于预测模型。实时检索器可以使用在所有可用文本上一次性训练的编码器（正如金融检索器通常的做法），但回测需要一个没有读过每个向量生成日期之后所写文本的编码器。为了解决这种前视偏差，我们从412,248个电话会议中，按照四种预训练方案训练了多个“版本”，截止日期从2010年到2024年逐年划分，每个版本只读取其截止日期当天或之前的文本。随后，我们在电话会议本身的问答对上对每个版本进行微调。仅用电话会议文本训练的版本（参数量3380万）在所有测试季度中，对留出电话会议的答案检索效果都优于我们测试的通用检索器。这些向量还将次日收益与基于过去收益和公司规模构建的预测之间的秩相关系数提高了约一半。当每个版本继续……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出按年度截止日期训练的“时点”文本编码器，以消除财报电话会议检索回测中的前视偏差，其小型专用模型在答案检索上全面优于通用检索器，并将收益预测的秩相关性提升约一半。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces point-in-time encoders for earnings calls trained as yearly vintages to eliminate look-ahead bias in backtesting, with small 33.8M-parameter call-trained models outperforming general retrievers in every test quarter and raising the rank correlation of return forecasts by about half.
